nodes.question: How have smart technologies in cities impacted the affordability of renewable energy products like solar panels and batteries?
nodes.answer: Smart technologies in cities have made renewable energy products such as solar panels and batteries more affordable by improving efficiency, enabling better integration, and reducing costs, ultimately making them more accessible to a wider population.
